# Requirements for the "paperwork" conda env on USC CARC.
# torch / torchvision are NOT here: scripts/setup_carc.sh installs them from
# the CUDA-specific PyTorch index (cu124).
#
# Floors, not exact pins. setup_carc.sh writes the resolved versions to
# env/requirements.lock.txt -- that is the file to trust for reproducing results.

# --- data -------------------------------------------------------------------
datasets>=3.0
pillow>=10.0               # also performs the JPEG re-encode defense

pandas>=2.0

# --- metrics ----------------------------------------------------------------
lpips>=0.1.4               # perceptibility
scikit-image>=0.24         # SSIM
scikit-learn>=1.5          # detector, AUROC, Brier
torchmetrics>=1.4

# --- notebooks --------------------------------------------------------------
ipykernel>=6.29
ipywidgets>=8,<9
matplotlib>=3.8
tqdm>=4.66

# NOTE (2026-09-22): the first install on CARC resolved to transformers 5.x,
# datasets 5.x and pandas 3.x -- all major versions ahead of what notebooks
# 01/02 were written against. If Qwen2.5-VL fails to load with a config or
# processor error, pin "transformers<5" and re-run. Do not pre-emptively
